notes.title: Regarding the phenomenon of not being able to select a translated version
notes.notes:
Currently, in addition to the main Japanese version, “Midnight Syndrome” is available in Chinese (Simplified), Korean, and Portuguese (Brazilian) versions.
The data should have been updated so that the game can be played on Steam, but we have confirmed a phenomenon where the language is not changed. This is due to my lack of skill and understanding.
But there is a solution. It requires several steps.

Enter the following command in the game Properties > Launch Options (the first part will vary depending on the installation path of the player) (see figure):.
F:\SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\MidnightSyndrome\[b]MidnightSyndrome_SC[/b](this part will vary depending on the language you choose)\Game_boxed.exe” %command%.

This procedure seems to solve the problem. (Someone who can help me with this told me this...)

I apologize for the trouble I have caused to international players who wanted to play my game.

If that does not solve the problem, you can download a translated version at the following link.
https://midnight-games.booth.pm/items/5617529

notes.title: Solved the phenomenon that players outside of Japan cannot play.
notes.notes:
This is an announcement from “Midnight Syndrome”.
Several overseas users have pointed out the problem of not being able to download the game.
Steam has provided a solution and we have attempted to do so.
Users who were unable to download the software should try downloading it again to see if the problem has been resolved.
We apologize for any inconvenience caused.
